hook.text: Recorded in Warsaw in January, and every track on it is written by the saxophonist who leads the group.

sentences.text: Zbigniew Namysłowski plays alto saxophone and wrote every track on the record.
Adam Matyszkowicz plays piano, Janusz Kozłowski plays double bass and Czesław Bartkowski plays drums.
The album was recorded in Warsaw in January 1966.
Wojciech Piętowski directed the recording, and Halina Jastrzębska was the sound engineer.
Polskie Nagrania Muza issued the LP in 1966, in a mono version (XL 0305) and a stereo version (SXL).
Both versions carry the matrix numbers XW-619 and XW-620.
The record was the sixth volume in the Polish Jazz series.
A CD reissue followed in 2004 as PNCD 306.
